title: Turn 'already applied' into link recovery sent to the address on file
tests_added: app/api/apply/[id]/reapply-capability-gate.test.ts (3 new tests + case-5 assertions on the existing one)
deviations_from_card: (1) The existing 'alreadyMessage' copy was NOT reworded. After this change it is used only on the proven paths (the ?lead= merge and the dedupeKey race), and both record re_applied, so 'we've noted your renewed interest' is true there. The unproven branches on both doors now answer recoveryMessageKey(relay). (2) The recovery email uses kind 'acknowledgement' rather than a new kind: adding a kind means editing comms-envelope.ts KNOWN_COMM_KINDS (a published relay contract, outside the write set). The subject (comms.linkRecovery.subject*) tells it apart. (3) recoveryMessageKey returns the apply-relative key ('alreadyMessageRecover' / 'alreadyMessageNoRelay'), which resolves to apply.* at the call site. (4) The orchestrator recoverApplicationLinks sits in apply-link-recovery.ts beside the pure decideLinkRecovery/recoveryMessageKey, so both doors share one call. (5) The quick route does an email-only findApplicationByApplicant BEFORE intakeLead. It sends a recovery only when the address was already on file, because a contactless name-matched lead is backfilled by lead-intake, which sends its own newly-reachable ack with links. Pinned by an extra test (one mail, not two). (6) 'Nothing written on the entry' has one exception: ensureLeadEnrichToken mints lead_token (and bumps updated_at) when the entry had none. This is the fill-only capability the card's flow step 2 names. (7) One test outside the write set was edited: apply-error-hygiene.test.ts pinned the old t("alreadyMessage") expression on the unproven branch. It now pins t(recoveryMessageKey(relayConfigured)), forbids alreadyMessage there, and forbids merge/consent/event writes inside the branch. (8) The rate-limit-contract test was not touched. The per-IP limiters are unchanged, and the per-entry cooldown uses login-throttle.
notes: Cases red before: 6 of 7. Case 5 (contactless entry, nothing sent, existing gate assertions hold) already passed, because nothing was ever sent. The cooldown is claimed with recordFailedAttempt(...) > 1 (an atomic UPSERT), not only with isThrottled.
